measurement_basis.round_noise_policy: Use the maximum observed per-round p95 as the measured p95 used for a budget, so a gate cannot be stricter than the measured round-to-round noise.
measurement_basis.workload: Production LayeredFullBodyRenderer and LayeredParametricFaceRenderer with the shipped official blue-white Hanfu outfit and classic makeup. Full-body cold starts a fresh renderer and clears QPixmapCache; hot switches warm both endpoints before timing; half-body switches cheek-rest to front-crossed after both are warm.
measurement_basis.scope: Offscreen compositor calls only; excludes the UI event loop, adapter publication, and unrelated window layout work.

cold_full_body.formula: over_target: budget_ms = measured_p95_ms; measured_p95_ms is the maximum p95 across the five baseline rounds so the budget is not tighter than observed round noise.
cold_full_body.reason: The measured p95 is already above the owner's 300 ms target. Keep the current measured value as a visible blocking baseline; do not multiply it by 1.5 or claim that the target is met.

hot_full_body_view_switch.reason: The warmed view switch is below the owner's 100 ms target; the target is the looser side of the required p95-times-1.5 comparison.

hot_half_body_silhouette_switch.reason: The warmed half-body silhouette switch is below the analogous 100 ms owner transition target; the target is the looser side of the required p95-times-1.5 comparison.

ci_gate.comparison: observed measurements.*.summary.p95_ms must be less than or equal to the corresponding budget_ms
ci_gate.cold_over_target_is_not_a_pass: cold_full_body remains over_target=true and is only a regression ceiling until the compositor is improved on a separate authorized change.
